newsitem.title: USA: ARI Network Services in directory venture.
newsitem.headline: ARI Network Services in directory venture.

text.p: ARI Network Services Inc on Tuesday said it formed a joint venture with RAPID Inc, an association of agricultural companies, to create a directory to facilitate electronic commerce with chemical dealers and related businesses.
The partners said the directory, featuring more than 32,000 agricultural chemical dealers and more than 74,000 related businesses, will be produced this month.
ARI said the directory would provide a central database that trading partners could use to identify business locations in their electronic commerce transations.
ARI provides Internet-enabled electronic commerce services.
Its shares were down 3/8 at 1-5/8 in early afternoon trading.
